semantic_input.title: The Henry Stickmin Collection
semantic_input.short_description: A choose-your-own-path where failing is more fun than succeeding.

semantic_input.title: Inscryption
semantic_input.short_description: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror into a blood-laced smoothie. Darker still are the secrets inscrybed upon the cards...

semantic_input.title: Tales of the Black Forest
semantic_input.short_description: In a world filled with yōkai, a surging dark power has overshadowed a Japanese town. A group of 2 developers have produced a Japanese pixel adventure game to tell a tale that dates back to the Heisei era...In the name of dreams and passion.

semantic_input.title: Arma 3
semantic_input.short_description: Experience true combat gameplay in a massive military sandbox. Deploy with a wide variety of single- and multiplayer content, a massive arsenal of modern weapons and vehicles, and limitless opportunities for content creation. Authentic, diverse, open - Arma 3 sends you to war.

semantic_input.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
semantic_input.short_description: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

semantic_input.title: Chicken Police - Paint it RED!
semantic_input.short_description: A wild tale of love, death, chickens, and redemption! Chicken Police is a buddy-cop noir adventure with a carefully crafted world, a gritty story, and absurd humor. The game mixes classic adventure games with visual novel-style storytelling, presented in a beak-droppingly unique art style.

semantic_input.title: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling
semantic_input.short_description: Follow Vi, Kabbu, and Leif as they uncover the secrets of the Land of Bugaria! Explore and combine your team's abilities to solve puzzles, defeat powerful enemies and find ancient treasures!

semantic_input.title: Exit From
semantic_input.short_description: Exit From - is a first-person horror-stealth game with quest and procedural generation elements where you have to get out of the old Soviet house, which changes every new game.

semantic_input.title: The Wild at Heart
semantic_input.short_description: Wield an ever-growing herd of quirky creatures to rebuild broken paths, battle perilous beasts, and solve peculiar puzzles in a rich, interconnected world. Join two young runaways as they unravel the mysteries of a lost realm in this nostalgic storybook fantasy!

semantic_input.title: Dry Drowning
semantic_input.short_description: Dry Drowning is a psychological investigative visual novel set in a futuristic dystopian city. Follow the story of Mordred Foley, unscrupulous private detective haunted by his dark past, and look into a series of macabre serial killings inspired by Greek mythology.

semantic_input.title: Blair Witch
semantic_input.short_description: A first-person, story-driven psychological horror game based on the cinematic lore of the Blair Witch. Explore the haunted grounds of the Black Hills Forest in a harrowing investigation that forces you to confront the evil that resides deep in the woods.

semantic_input.title: Rebel Inc: Escalation
semantic_input.short_description: A unique and deeply engaging political/military strategic simulation from the creator of Plague Inc. Balance competing civilian and military priorities and deal with a deadly insurgency in order to stabilise a war-torn country.

semantic_input.title: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
semantic_input.short_description: The party-based RPG where you kick down doors and fight with music as a 3-piece band of idiots.

semantic_input.title: She Sees Red - Interactive Movie
semantic_input.short_description: She Sees Red is a mature, hard-boiled interactive thriller. When someone is killed inside a nightclub, an experienced detective vows to put the murderer behind bars. Make choices that affect the narrative and experience several different endings in this blood-red interactive movie.

semantic_input.title: Mutazione
semantic_input.short_description: A mutant soap opera where small-town gossip meets the supernatural. Explore the Mutazione community as Kai as she cares for her ailing grandfather. Discover magical gardens, new friends & old secrets. They can survive an apocalyptic meteor strike, but can they survive their small-town drama?

semantic_input.title: Space Pirates and Zombies
semantic_input.short_description: Explore a randomly generated Galaxy populated with factions, enemies, missions, and items providing you with a unique experience each time you play.

semantic_input.title: My Time at Sandrock
semantic_input.short_description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

semantic_input.title: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4
semantic_input.short_description:
ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action!

Based on the concept of "experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield," buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world!
